family: The single total MOD-3 family defined in proof.md Section 1: for every integer n>=0 and x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x)=1 iff the number of ones in x is congruent to 0 mod 3 (so f_0=1 on the empty string). One linear-time algorithm keeping a counter mod 3 evaluates it at every length; the NP verifier is V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and that algorithm accepts x, with witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform linear-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-3 for EVERY integer n>=2 at actual input length n=|x| in the full Li–Yang B2 model (self-contained Schnorr-style gate elimination in proof.md), hence C_B2(f_n)>=2n-o(n) and liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=2.
